config.title: Herbstferien Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: The autumn school holiday dates, what the Hort covers, and the cheapest ways to fill the two weeks.

items.q: When are the Herbstferien in Berlin in 2026?
items.a: From **Monday 19 October to Saturday 31 October 2026**. The last school day is Friday 16 October and school starts again on Monday 2 November. In 2027 the autumn break is 11 to 23 October.

items.q: Does the Hort stay open in the Herbstferien?
items.a: Yes. The holidays are part of ergänzende Förderung und Betreuung (eFöB), so a child with a Hort place is cared for in the holidays too. Many Horte staff the holidays from a list of the days parents need, so **return that list early**.

items.q: How long does the Hort look after children in the holidays?
items.a: For grades 1 to 3 the care from **7:30 to 16:00 is free and needs no needs check.** Early care from 6:00 and late care until 18:00 are extra modules. At an open all-day school the guaranteed core is 7:30 to 13:30.

items.q: Can I still get a Hort place for these holidays?
items.a: Not through a new application. Berlin asks for the application **at least three months before** care should start, and the decision takes six to eight weeks. For these two weeks only an existing Hort place helps.

items.q: What does the Super-Ferien-Pass cost and what is included?
items.a: It costs **€9** and is valid in every school holiday from summer 2026 to Easter 2027 for Berlin children up to and including 18. It includes one free swim a day in the Berliner Bäder indoor pools (entry by 12:00, out by 14:00) and coupons such as free Zoo and Tierpark entry up to age 15.

items.q: Is 31 October a holiday in Berlin?
items.a: No. **Reformationstag is a public holiday in Brandenburg, not in Berlin.** In 2026 it falls on Saturday 31 October, so shops in Potsdam and the rest of Brandenburg are closed that day while Berlin shops are open.
